flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (if any bills or people exist @v16:"clear this site's browser storage and reload").
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.

Open Settle up to confirm payments are listed, then return to the bills.
Delete the Electricity bill, then open Settle up.
Assert Settle up shows a payment where Ben pays Ana 300.00.
Store The payment line in Settle up where Ben pays Ana, including the amount as {{ben_pays_ana}}.
